**Other:** MLX 0.32.4 with native kernels built through MLX's MetalExtension (@XXXXRT666 in #4550), mlx-vlm 0.7.8 (#4529), the Chinese README (@JasonYeYuhe in #3329), and the MCP restart note (@ketpatil77, e0c24bfb6). ## Bug Fixes - Splash stops generating when the client disconnects (#4575 with @GigaFyde), and the thinking budget now reaches Splash instead of running until `max_tokens` (@GigaFyde in #4576). - DFlash releases buffers that finished requests no longer use (@samfenwick in #4567). - Lightning MTP no longer aborts a batch with an IndexError after its draft depth drops (@junmo-kim in #4410). - Stop strings end the answer, not the reasoning, on chat and messages (@HamedShams in #4352), and `thinking_budget` closes thinking the way the template renders it on Qwen3.6 and Gemma 4 (@richgoodson in #4539). - DeepSeek V4.1 tool calls that end without the outer close tag come back as `tool_calls` (91718c950), V4 reasoning no longer repeats in content on tool-call turns (@williamxie1989, 611540b05), and Qwen XML tool calls keep `anyOf` string/null values as strings (@yanzhaohui1999 in #4544). - Cache fixes: deduplicated prefix blocks are pinned before reuse (#4443 with @billythegod), prompts shorter than one block hit the cache (@Woody-Hu in #4428, c756df2a5), LFM2 reuses prefixes (@alan13367 in #4532), padded prefill keeps GDN state exact (#4526), and long-running Qwen3.5 batches no longer hit the Metal resource limit (41166afa2). - TurboQuant batches no longer let left-padded rows read their padding in Qwen3.5/3.6 decode (#4453). - Memory guard fixes: prompts that fit are no longer rejected right after a request frees memory, a rejection keeps the cache for the retry (#4554), queued requests wait while running ones make progress (a987407f0), and fp16 Qwen3.8-Flash-Next builds use less prefill memory and reach longer contexts again (89a40d113). - `/v1/systemone` no longer returns 500 when the decision model is unloaded during encode (013bc3f3a), and the ANE tuner keeps the verified result when its last step fails (e292a3bb8). - A failed STT load no longer hangs the server (@Flo5k5 in #4542). The macOS app no longer blocks logout, restart and shutdown (e860713f7), and it picks up an API key set after launch (8e1e3869f). - VLM requests with back-to-back user messages work on strict templates (64bf5d1ba), OptiQ VLM checkpoints load as VLMs again (@Woody-Hu in #4549), and Gemma 4 unified models keep the image settings from `processor_config.json` (@paalolav in #4560). - Downloads report gated repos as gated (e870cb9e6 with @yanzhaohui1999), ModelScope rows show the right owner and size (@yanzhaohui1999 in #4555), and re-downloading an updated model no longer counts bytes twice in the progress bar (@alan13367 in #4558). - Cluster: hybrid models without `layer_types` reserve KV only for attention layers, pipeline ranks stay up during long prefills (#4553), and CUDA workers match MLX 0.32.4 (c73e8fc20). - oQ jobs can no longer write to the same output folder (#4443), DeepSeek V4.1 oQ3 runs again (3f99250d6), and GLM-5.3 oQe calibrates its MTP head (7388337f7). - LiveCodeBench grades functional problems by return value (@yanzhaohui1999 in #4545). ## Highlights from 0.7.1.dev1 - **Decision models.** Clef, Clef-Flash and OpenJev return a probability for each option of typed questions through `POST /v1/systemone` (#4315). - **Batched prefill.** Concurrent prompts prefill in one forward, cutting mean TTFT by 11-25% on Qwen3.8 and GLM-5.3-Flash (#4361, built on #3888 by @chenqianhe). - **Faster models.** Qwen3.8-Flash-Next decode up to +133%, Qwen3.6-35B-A3B +31%, GLM-5.3-Flash +30% on M3 and M4, and DeepSeek V4.1 Flash first run +48%. - **Refreshed web UI.** A log table, a settings section rail, a status header and a customizable Serving Stats block (#4364, from the redesign by @LXD-8 in #3849 and #3850). Benchmarks and every contributor credit are in the [0.7.1.dev1 release notes](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/releases/tag/v0.7.1.dev1). ## Upgrade Notes - **Source installs:** run `make install` (or `make dev`) after updating. oMLX now uses MLX 0.32.4, and native kernels built for the previous MLX are rejected and fall back to slower paths (#4550). Upgrade every Mac in a cluster at the same time. - **Environment variables:** about 150 debug `OMLX_*` variables are removed and now ignored, including `OMLX_MOE_EXPERT_OFFLOAD`, `OMLX_QWEN35_ANE_PREFILL` and `OMLX_RDMA_STAGE_LINKS`. Use the per-model settings instead (#4396). - **macOS app:** the app no longer links `omlx` into `/opt/homebrew/bin`, and it asks before removing a link left by an older version (#4341). - **DFlash:** dflash-mlx is removed. Settings only the old engine read (DFlash in-memory and SSD caches, `dflash_max_ctx`, sink size, draft quantization) are gone, a saved `ddtree` verify mode loads as `adaptive`, and changing a DFlash setting reloads the model (#4508). - **Sampling defaults:** models without saved sampling settings now use the values in their `generation_config.json`. Qwen models without top_k/top_p get 20 / 0.95 and Gemma models 64 / 0.95. Saved settings are not changed (#4416). - **YaRN:** a per-model context window above 262,144 on a Qwen3.5-family model now turns on YaRN for every prompt, so keep the window near the length you need (#4445). - **LiveCodeBench:** scores from earlier versions were graded the old way and are not comparable (#4545). ## New Contributors @AureliusClaw in #4070, @Bannng in #4390, @billythegod in #4163, @e-Garcia in #4123, @HamedShams in #4379, @Jason-Barbour in #4389, @junmooo in #4138, @Marian2110 in #4169, @masterfasa in #4147, @mdc2122 in #4169, @N1k1tung in #4338, @Nek-12 in #3736, @ngutech21 in #4336, @no84by in #4377, @Weschera in #4253, @yeeeeff in #4351, @Zcg2021 in #4151, @jandrop in #4431, @mudravadev in #4497, @Woody-Hu in #4428, @Ambisphaeric in #4464, @Cassian433 in #4510, @feni6 in #4540, @Flo5k5 in #4542, @fneto1977 in #4525, @XXXXRT666 in #4550, @GigaFyde in #4576. **Full Changelog**: https://github.com/jundot/omlx/compare/v0.7.0...v0.7.1rc1

The macOS app no longer blocks logout, restart and shutdown (e860713f7), and it picks up an API key set after launch (8e1e3869f). - VLM requests with back-to-back user messages work on strict templates (64bf5d1ba), and OptiQ VLM checkpoints load as VLMs again (@Woody-Hu in #4549). - Downloads report gated repos as gated (e870cb9e6 with @yanzhaohui1999), and ModelScope rows show the right owner and size (@yanzhaohui1999 in #4555). - Cluster: hybrid models without `layer_types` reserve KV only for attention layers, pipeline ranks stay up during long prefills (#4553), and CUDA workers match MLX 0.32.4 (c73e8fc20). - oQ jobs can no longer write to the same output folder (#4443), DeepSeek V4.1 oQ3 runs again (3f99250d6), and GLM-5.3 oQe calibrates its MTP head (7388337f7). - LiveCodeBench grades functional problems by return value (@yanzhaohui1999 in #4545). ## Upgrade Notes - **Source installs:** run `make install` (or `make dev`) after updating. oMLX now uses MLX 0.32.4, and native kernels built for the previous MLX are rejected and fall back to slower paths (#4550). Upgrade every Mac in a cluster at the same time. - **DFlash:** dflash-mlx is removed. Settings only the old engine read (DFlash in-memory and SSD caches, `dflash_max_ctx`, sink size, draft quantization) are gone, a saved `ddtree` verify mode loads as `adaptive`, and changing a DFlash setting reloads the model (#4508). - **Sampling defaults:** models without saved sampling settings now use the values in their `generation_config.json`. Qwen models without top_k/top_p get 20 / 0.95 and Gemma models 64 / 0.95. Saved settings are not changed (#4416). - **YaRN:** a per-model context window above 262,144 on a Qwen3.5-family model now turns on YaRN for every prompt, so keep the window near the length you need (#4445). - **LiveCodeBench:** scores from earlier versions were graded the old way and are not comparable (#4545). ## New Contributors @jandrop in #4431, @mudravadev in #4497, @Woody-Hu in #4428, @Ambisphaeric in #4464, @Cassian433 in #4510, @feni6 in #4540, @Flo5k5 in #4542, @fneto1977 in #4525, @XXXXRT666 in #4550. **Full Changelog**: https://github.com/jundot/omlx/compare/v0.7.1.dev1...v0.7.1.dev2

# oMLX 0.7.1.dev1

> This is a development release. Please report any bugs through [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/issues/new/choose). If you need a stable release, please use [oMLX 0.7.0](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/releases/tag/v0.7.0).

oMLX 0.7.1.dev1 adds decision models, prefills concurrent prompts together, speeds up Qwen3.8, Qwen3.6, GLM-5.3-Flash and DeepSeek V4.1, and refreshes the web UI.

**Download:** [macOS 26 / 27](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/releases/download/v0.7.1.dev1/oMLX-0.7.1.dev1-macos26-27.dmg) | [macOS 15 Sequoia](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/releases/download/v0.7.1.dev1/oMLX-0.7.1.dev1-macos15-sequoia.dmg)

## Decision Models: Clef and OpenJev

oMLX now serves decision models through `POST /v1/systemone`, which follows the TypeSafe System One API. They read a state once and return a probability for each option of typed questions (`noul`, `choice`, `score`) instead of generating text. Clef and Clef-Flash (27B, 9B, text and images) and OpenJev (27B, text and one image) are detected automatically, or you can set the model type to `decision`. oQ keeps Clef's joint head intact, and ready-made [Jundot/clef-oQ4e](https://huggingface.co/Jundot/clef-oQ4e) and [Jundot/clef-flash-oQ4e](https://huggingface.co/Jundot/clef-flash-oQ4e) checkpoints are available. #4315

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/9eaa60c0-e0d1-4597-a1e9-95bddad7cdd2

## Batched Prefill for Concurrent Requests

When several requests prefill at the same time, their chunks now run in one forward, so MoE expert weights are read once instead of once per request. There is no new setting, and each request keeps its own cache. It covers Qwen3.5/3.6/3.8, Qwen3.8-Flash-Next, GLM-5.3 and Hy3. #4361, built on #3888 by @chenqianhe.

Mean time to first token, before -> after:

| Model | Hardware | 8 prompts at once | 8 prompts 0.4 s apart | 4 prompts joining 4 decoding streams |
|---|---|---:|---:|---:|
| Qwen3.8-Flash-Next oQ4e | M5 Max | 2.08 -> 1.81 s (-13%) | 7.41 -> 5.75 s (-22%) | 1.65 -> 1.31 s (-21%) |
| GLM-5.3-Flash oQ4e (first 20 layers) | M5 Max | 1.92 -> 1.68 s (-12%) | 6.83 -> 5.15 s (-25%) | 1.09 -> 1.00 s (-8%) |
| Qwen3.8-Flash-Next oQ4e | M3 Ultra | 3.18 -> 2.68 s (-16%) | 15.12 -> 12.79 s (-15%) | 2.32 -> 1.97 s (-15%) |
| Qwen3.8-27B oQ4e | M3 Ultra | 8.77 -> 7.80 s (-11%) | 36.66 -> 32.52 s (-11%) | 6.11 -> 5.10 s (-17%) |

## Faster Qwen3.8, Qwen3.6, GLM-5.3-Flash and DeepSeek V4.1

| Model | Change | Hardware |
|---|---|---|
| Qwen3.8-Flash-Next, group size 32 checkpoints | Decode 39 -> 91 tok/s (+133%) with MTP off, 98 -> 134 tok/s (+37%) with MTP on | M3 Ultra |
| Qwen3.8-Flash-Next | Decode with 4 streams at 12-24K context +12%, single request +4-5% | M5 Max, M3 Ultra |
| Qwen3.8-Flash-Next with expert offload | 32K prefill 396 -> 636 tok/s (+61%) | M3 Ultra |
| Qwen3.6-35B-A3B | Decode 156 -> 205 tok/s (+31%) | M5 Max |
| Qwen3.8-27B oQ8e with INT8 activation prefill | Prefill +25% at 4K, +38% at 16K | M5 Max |
| GLM-5.3-Flash | Decode on M3 and M4 31.3 -> 40.6 tok/s (+30%), DFlash2 +8-9% | M3 Ultra |
| DeepSeek V4.1 Flash | First run 13.2 -> 19.6 tok/s (+48%), decode 20.0 -> 21.0 tok/s (+5%), DSpark rewrites 40.4 -> 45.9 tok/s (+14%) | M3 Ultra |
| Lightning MTP on Qwen, Gemma 4, GLM-5.3 and MiMo | File edits 1.5-2x faster at temperature 1.0 | M3 Ultra |

Each figure is measured against the code right before the change. By @jerryfane (#4052, #4055, #4062, #4104, #4105, #4106, #4112, #4245, #4248), @AureliusClaw (#4070), @hojin12312 (#4320, #4350, #4387), @samfenwick (#4113, ported in #4335), @yeeeeff (00decff), @junmo-kim (#4255, #4324), @N1k1tung (#4338, #4342) and @ngutech21 (#4336), plus #4240 and #4313. The DeepSeek V4.1 changes (#4354, #4360, #4363, #4365) are adapted from the [m5-ultra](https://github.com/tacos8me/m5-ultra) work by @tacos8me.

## A Refreshed Web UI

The dashboard is rebuilt around the redesign @LXD-8 proposed in #3849 and #3850: a log table with level badges and a detail panel, a settings section rail with copy links, pinned sub-tabs, a status header with Restart and Unload all, grouped benchmark presets, and a Serving Stats block you can customize (#4399). #4364, with follow-ups by @LXD-8 in #4392 and #4394.

## New Features and Improvements

- **Memory guard:** frees old hot cache before rejecting a prompt, avoids full KV copies when a long request joins a batch, and `balanced` now counts a quarter of other apps' memory as reclaimable (#4252, #4312 with @luken, #4372).
- **Video input for Qwen3.5/3.6/3.8**, with per-clip prefix caching and cached vision features for follow-up turns. By @Marian2110 and @mdc2122 (#4169).
- **oQe refit:** a weighted least-squares refit of group scales and biases cuts KL to the original model by 11-15%. Only new conversions change (#4385).
- **Prefill progress:** `return_progress: true` streams llama.cpp-style `prompt_progress` chunks (#4362, from the idea by @alytaphoenix in #2980).
- **vLLM-compatible `/tokenize` and `/detokenize`** (#4331).
- **Headless mode:** `omlx serve --headless` runs without the web UI, and the admin API accepts the main API key as a Bearer token (#4359).
- **Embeddings and rerank:** EmbeddingGemma 2 with image and audio input (#4333, @Bannng in #4390), a rerank `instruction` (@Jason-Barbour in #4389), rerank `max_length` (#4168), and native BERT/XLM-R outputs that match transformers (#4170).
- **Cluster:** forget offline Macs, pairing guidance and the SSD cache on by default (@lybertybox443 in #4097, #4143, #4145, #4146). Qwen3.5 dense models run pipeline parallel, hybrid models are charged KV only for full-attention layers, and dead ranks are recovered (@masterfasa in #4147, #4148, #4208).
- **Hardening:** update signature checks, a request body size cap and the inline audio limit (@billythegod in #4164, #4188, #4190).
- **Other:** faster unload settle (@yanzhaohui1999 in #4162), DFlash draft name resolution and warnings (@yanzhaohui1999 in #3310, #4299; @e-Garcia in #4123), mlx-vlm 0.7.7, mlx-audio 0.5.7, xgrammar 0.2.8, and the MLX version in Engine Versions (#1611).

## Bug Fixes

- Requests no longer stall after error recovery (#4186), and SpecPrefill state is cleared after failures (@tc3oliver in #4035).
- A Metal out-of-memory error no longer leaves the server answering 507 until restart (@no84by in #4377). Public unload ends active streams (@HamedShams in #4379), and aborted requests get a 409.
- Tool call parsing fixes, plus stable tool schema order for prefix cache reuse (@samfenwick in #4129, @ddark-il in #4008, @billythegod in #4196, @yanzhaohui1999 in #4300, @junmooo in #4138).
- Structured output keeps Unicode and returns JSON verbatim (@arnavprabhu in #4384), MiniMax-M3 applies the schema after thinking (#4316), and bare structured output skips thinking budgets (@samfenwick in #4127).
- Cache fixes: block eviction, SSD temp files and torn writes (@billythegod in #4163, #4180), 34 GiB less transient memory on a 1M-token restore (@junmo-kim in #4167), no duplicate KV in completion snapshots (#4314), and correct `cached_tokens` after prefill pauses (@arnavprabhu in #4383).
- Loading fixes for mixed-quantization GLM-5.3 checkpoints and their quantized routers (@junmo-kim in #4178, #4184), the MiniMax-M3 sparse cache (#4228), quantized Qwen3-ASR (@arnavprabhu in #4382), and Fish/TADA/LongCat `ref_audio` (@yanzhaohui1999 in #4304).
- API fixes for the Responses final text and keepalive (@Nek-12 in #3736, @Zcg2021 in #4151), Anthropic unknown blocks and adaptive thinking (@yanzhaohui1999 in #4201, #4301), lone surrogates (@Weschera in #4253), and text-only VLM templates (@yanzhaohui1999 in #4307).
- Kernel routing fixes for q2 NAX, GDN, FA256 and TurboQuant (@alytaphoenix in #3083, #3092, #3096, #3127), and Qwen3.8 prefill memory pricing (@mvdbos in #3482).
- The macOS app's global profile saves keep model settings (#4249). Web UI fixes by @zviratko (#4176, #3892), @billythegod (#4191) and @yanzhaohui1999 (#4298, #3281).
- Cluster, download and packaging fixes by @lybertybox443, @billythegod, @alytaphoenix, @yanzhaohui1999, @samfenwick and @zviratko (#4080, #4189, #3152, #4373, #4125, #4305, #4192, #4200, #4155, #4183, #4134).
- HumanEval answers that contain only the function body are scored correctly (d1a928d).

## Upgrade Notes

- **Source installs:** run `make kernels` after updating. oMLX now uses MLX 0.32.3, and kernels built for the previous MLX are rejected and fall back to slower paths (#4311). Upgrade every Mac in a cluster at the same time.
- **Environment variables:** about 150 debug `OMLX_*` variables are removed and now ignored, including `OMLX_MOE_EXPERT_OFFLOAD`, `OMLX_QWEN35_ANE_PREFILL` and `OMLX_RDMA_STAGE_LINKS`. Use the per-model settings instead (#4396).
- **macOS app:** the app no longer links `omlx` into `/opt/homebrew/bin`, and it asks before removing a link left by an older version (#4341).

## New Contributors

@AureliusClaw in #4070, @Bannng in #4390, @billythegod in #4163, @e-Garcia in #4123, @HamedShams in #4379, @Jason-Barbour in #4389, @junmooo in #4138, @Marian2110 in #4169, @masterfasa in #4147, @mdc2122 in #4169, @N1k1tung in #4338, @Nek-12 in #3736, @ngutech21 in #4336, @no84by in #4377, @Weschera in #4253, @yeeeeff in #4351, @Zcg2021 in #4151.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/jundot/omlx/compare/v0.7.0...v0.7.1.dev1

# oMLX 0.7.0 After a long wait, oMLX 0.7.0 is out. oMLX 0.7.0 brings faster Qwen3.8, GLM-5.3-Flash and MiMo V2 inference, a completely rebuilt memory guard, and fixes for the regressions reported against the release candidate. The notes below cover changes since 0.7.0rc1. **Download:** [macOS 26 / 27](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/releases/download/v0.7.0/oMLX-0.7.0-macos26-27.dmg) | [macOS 15 Sequoia](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/releases/download/v0.7.0/oMLX-0.7.0-macos15-sequoia.dmg) ## Faster Qwen3.8-Flash-Next - **Prefill.** Wider prefill steps, exact hyper-connection fusions, QSA attention on the M5 tensor units and wider native QSA tiles. By @jonathan308 in [#3980](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/pull/3980), [#3981](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/pull/3981), [#3982](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/pull/3982), [#4020](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/pull/4020); @jerryfane in [#3934](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/pull/3934). - **MoE prefill.** Fused gate/up gathers with a SwiGLU epilogue and segmented NAX tile scheduling, with identical greedy output. Oversized sorted MoE calls on M5 run in one dispatch instead of 32K-row slices. By @jonathan308 in [#3995](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/pull/3995), [#4022](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/pull/4022), [#4029](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/pull/4029); @jerryfane in [#3954](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/pull/3954). - **Decode.** Fused MoE, DeltaNet and attention kernels for one-token decode and MTP verify windows, and routed experts run in two launches instead of five. By @jerryfane in [#4024](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/pull/4024), [#4038](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/pull/4038), [#4039](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/pull/4039), [#4041](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/pull/4041); @wyanzhao in [#3912](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/pull/3912). - **Exact Lightning MTP.** For a single request, verify rows are now bit-identical to serial decode, so turning Lightning MTP on does not change greedy output. By @jerryfane in [#4023](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/pull/4023). - **Qwen3.5/3.6 GDN prefill.** A software-pipelined GDN recurrence speeds up Qwen3.5/3.6 VLM prefill. By @jonathan308 in [#4006](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/pull/4006). ## Faster Qwen3.8 Lightning MTP and DFlash2 DFlash2 and Lightning MTP now do less work per verify cycle on Qwen3.8-27B and Qwen3.8-Flash-Next, with the largest gains at long contexts. The fp16 checkpoints used on GPUs without native bf16 now use the same verify kernels. Flash-Next no longer falls back to plain decode at 64K on M3 Ultra, and after a performance park MTP resumes with its full head history instead of an empty one. [#3958](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/pull/3958). ## Faster GLM-5.3-Flash - **Prefill.** Pipelined per-layer evaluation, fused hyper-connection kernels, a blocked KDA recurrence, tensor-unit DSA indexer and sparse MLA attention, and 4096-token chunks on M5 GPUs. By @jonathan308 in [#3971](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/pull/3971), [#3983](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/pull/3983), [#3984](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/pull/3984), [#3985](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/pull/3985), [#3986](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/pull/3986), [#3988](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/pull/3988), [#3996](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/pull/3996), [#4025](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/pull/4025). This builds on the earlier Qwen4 prefill port by @williamxie1989 in [#3944](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/pull/3944). - **Decode.** Exact fused decode and MTP verify kernels on M5 GPUs, plus cheaper decode steps on every Mac, with unchanged output. By @jonathan308 in [#3989](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/pull/3989), [#4019](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/pull/4019), [#4026](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/pull/4026). - **DFlash2.** GLM-5.3-Flash now works as a DFlash2 target with the incoai/GLM-5.3-Flash-DFlash2 draft. By @jonathan308 in [#3979](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/pull/3979). ## Faster MiMo V2 Blocked sliding-window attention, JIT NAX attention kernels for 192/128 head dims, long-context attention in key-range passes, a fused decode and verify layer path, and wider prefill chunks (4096 tokens, 8192 on M5 GPUs). MiMo experts also combine through the fused weighted-sum kernel, and MiMo and GLM-5.3 run expert gate/up as one gather. By @jonathan308 in [#3972](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/pull/3972), [#3973](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/pull/3973), [#3990](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/pull/3990), [#3991](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/pull/3991), [#3992](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/pull/3992), [#3994](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/pull/3994), [#4032](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/pull/4032), [#4033](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/pull/4033), [#3977](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/pull/3977), [#3993](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/pull/3993). ## A Completely Rebuilt Memory Guard The previous memory guard could refuse a prompt even when there was still memory to spare, or try one when there wasn't enough. The memory guard in 0.7.0 was rebuilt from scratch. It helps oMLX use as much of your memory as it safely can, and with the `aggressive` tier that means close to all of it. Tiers now set how much memory stays free for other apps: `safe` keeps about 20% of RAM (6-16 GB), `balanced` about 8% (3-8 GB) and `aggressive` about 2% (1.5-4 GB). If you turned the memory guard off before, try turning it back on. [#3933](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/pull/3933). ## New Features and Improvements - **Faster image follow-ups on Qwen3.8-Flash-Next.** Vision features are cached per image and only new images are encoded, within a 1 GiB memory budget. In a four-turn screenshot conversation, a text-only follow-up started in 0.33s instead of 3.32s. By @williamxie1989 in [#3955](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/pull/3955). - **Lightning MTP with expert offload for Qwen3.8-Flash-Next.** The MTP head stays resident while backbone experts stream from the checkpoint. By @samad-aghaei in [#3935](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/pull/3935). - **Live concurrency changes.** `max_concurrent_requests` applies without unloading models. By @zviratko in [#3765](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/pull/3765). - **Download queues.** Each row shows a live transfer rate, queues survive a restart, progress follows xet's fetch phase and cancel stops the transfer right away. By @LXD-8 in [#3875](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/pull/3875). Also addresses [#505](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/issues/505). - **DeepSeek Harness.** Launch DeepSeek Harness (dsh) with oMLX as its provider. By @LXD-8 in [#3950](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/pull/3950). - **Less GPU wake-up delay.** oMLX keeps the GPU out of its idle power state for up to 5 minutes after the last request, which removed about 1 to 1.5 seconds from the next time to first token in MiMo tests. The interval is `server.gpu_keep_warm_interval` in settings.json. By @jonathan308 in [#3974](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/pull/3974). - **Less per-request tokenizer work.** The streaming detokenizer is built once per tokenizer instead of on every request, which saves about 45 ms per request on Qwen3.8. By @jonathan308 in [#3975](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/pull/3975). - **Faster expert offload on slow storage.** Offloaded expert reads overlap with resident expert compute during decode. By @srcterm in [#4037](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/pull/4037). - **Exact prefix reuse for split-GDN SpecPrefill.** Stable system and tool prefixes are no longer prefilled on every request. By @jerryfane in [#3908](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/pull/3908). - **Embedding precision.** bf16 Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B and -8B checkpoints are promoted to fp16, which keeps their output within the conformance tolerance. By @ernestas-poskus in [#3640](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/pull/3640). - **Accuracy runs.** Local runs record answers cut off by the token limit. By @beatakouchnir in [#3945](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/pull/3945). - **Cluster SSH accounts.** Set a persistent SSH account for each paired Mac in the wizard, and pairing shares SSH account names. By @lybertybox443 in [#4075](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/pull/4075); [0905fad](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/commit/0905fadf589bc9e9994c0796d1957f482be63773). ## Bug Fixes - **ANE prefill.** A TypeError in 0.7.0rc1 disabled ANE prefill and left no GDN procedures eligible. Addresses [#3957](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/issues/3957). - **oQ A8 prefill on M5.** Dense Qwen 4-bit projections silently fell back to W4A16 in 0.7.0rc1. Addresses [#3952](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/issues/3952). - **Clustering.** Helper Python processes no longer inherit the app's PYTHONHOME, rank failures are reported instead of masked, and ranks follow the mlx-lm 0.32 server and pipeline APIs. Addresses [#3937](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/issues/3937), [#3965](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/issues/3965), [#3966](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/issues/3966) and [#3967](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/issues/3967). - **Muse Glimmer with DFlash.** The dflash-mlx pin now works with mlx-lm 0.32 for Muse Glimmer, and Muse Glimmer DFlash can reuse prefix snapshots. Addresses [#4009](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/issues/4009). - **Accuracy benchmarks.** Client disconnects no longer stall a run, saving settings during a run no longer cancels it, forced LM loads skip model families that only mlx-vlm implements, and Metal out-of-memory load failures are no longer cached as broken files. Addresses [#3956](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/issues/3956), [#3960](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/issues/3960) and [#3961](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/issues/3961), and part of [#3959](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/issues/3959). - **Lightning MTP for MLX-converted MiMo checkpoints.** The MTP sidecar loads with the correct tensor-parallel split, raising acceptance to 83-89% and decode from 43-45 to 53-57 tok/s on M3 Ultra. By @jonathan308 in [#3976](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/pull/3976). - **Lightning MTP batching.** A late join hands off instead of replaying a row's whole history, and greedy verify picks tokens like the serial sampler. By @yoyo930021 in [#4031](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/pull/4031); @jerryfane in [#4050](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/pull/4050). - **Decode attention.** Declared threadgroup limits fix incorrect native decode attention on M1 Max, and the decode fallback keeps causal masking. By @samfenwick in [#4063](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/pull/4063), [#4064](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/pull/4064). - **Qwen3.5/3.6 VLM numerics.** GDN q/k normalization now matches mlx-lm and the reference model. SSD prefix blocks computed with the old numerics are rebuilt once. [5f70e46](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/commit/5f70e462ba458f951f4ed9abb8967acc61f589a1). - **SSD cache growth on hybrid models.** GDN, QSA, GLM-5 linear and DeepSeek V4.1 layouts kept one full-state cache tail per turn. Tails from two turns back are now deleted. [a28e5a8](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/commit/a28e5a87be49e8e5f8d5e91773e513ea32f05750). - **Sampling.** Small top_p values no longer mask every token in bf16 and fp16, and XTC no longer takes its cutoff across batch rows. [4255940](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/commit/4255940d356e476270f820d70a81a261acce80be). - **Qwen3.8-Flash-Next loading.** The n-gram table shards are released during load, so larger quants like oQ8e load reliably. By @agg23 in [#4087](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/pull/4087). - **DeepSeek V4.1 images.** A literal image placeholder in text no longer causes repeated 400 errors, and /v1/responses drops input images for text-only models. By @Mast0089 in [#4011](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/pull/4011). Addresses [#4010](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/issues/4010) and [#4069](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/issues/4069). - **Gemma 4 audio.** Audio weights with Hugging Face names are recognized, so gemma-4-E2B-it transcribes audio instead of dropping it. Audio models key the prefix cache on the audio content, so two clips with the same prompt no longer share a cached transcript, and oQ conversion loads 0-dim tensors, so gemma-4-E2B-it can be quantized. By @vichzp in [#4117](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/pull/4117), [#4118](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/pull/4118), [#4119](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/pull/4119). Addresses [#4114](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/issues/4114), [#4115](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/issues/4115) and [#4116](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/issues/4116). - **Gemma 4 multi-audio and chat template.** Several audio clips in one request no longer fail with a 500, and later clips keep their own placeholders. Prompts render with the tokenizer chat template, so each audio marker stays in its own turn and list system content is no longer printed as a Python list. [077f6b4](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/commit/077f6b468d844eec0f2e454fa1c71e6d723454af), [8cc02d6](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/commit/8cc02d691d25ed0aed3d8e897d7f2afc94f3b554). - **Qwen fused GDN norm.** The fused GDN norm uses the same SiLU arithmetic as the served path, which removes small mismatches in fp16 and on large negative gates. By @samfenwick in [#4122](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/pull/4122). - **Tool calling.** Hy3 reads its tool parser template from the tokenizer, and repositories that label non-JSON tool grammars as `json_tools` use the parser their template needs. By @lybertybox443 in [#4076](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/pull/4076); [0724417](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/commit/07244176d8ef5d6c084f27188c97cbaa12995931). - **Prefill admission after eviction.** A request no longer gets an HTTP 400 right after the pool frees enough memory for it, because the scheduler refreshes its memory sample before the final admission check. By @samfenwick in [#4124](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/pull/4124). Addresses [#4059](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/issues/4059). - **Structured output.** JSON schema decoding bounds whitespace, so a string closed early no longer spins until `max_tokens`. By @saichowdary007 in [#3321](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/pull/3321). Addresses [#2990](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/issues/2990). - **GLM-5.3 indexer parity.** Fused decode keeps the same top-k order as the general indexer when native top-k is unavailable. By @lybertybox443 in [#4098](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/pull/4098). - **Cluster reliability.** SSD prefixes are restored after a memory cache rejection, admitted prefill respects SSD snapshot boundaries, staging uses the published worker shim, SFTP transfers keep literal paths, SSH probing stops after a transport failure, and pairing can retry after an initial connection failure. By @lybertybox443 in [#4078](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/pull/4078), [#4079](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/pull/4079), [#4092](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/pull/4092), [#4093](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/pull/4093), [#4094](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/pull/4094), [#4095](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/pull/4095), [#4096](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/pull/4096). - **Unexpected model reloads.** TurboQuant bit depth is stored the same way in settings and profiles, so model aliases no longer trigger reloads. By @zviratko in [#3616](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/pull/3616). - **Qwen3-VL embeddings.** Position ids are recomputed per request. By @zviratko in [#3874](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/pull/3874). Addresses [#3731](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/issues/3731). - **Gemma 4 oQ conversions.** The MoE router stays at source precision. By @andyoneal in [#4107](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/pull/4107). - **Usage statistics.** Non-streaming responses report token rates, and rates for uncached prefill are correct. By @junmo-kim in [#4065](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/pull/4065). - **Throughput bench.** Runs that stop within the first 16 tokens no longer report a decode rate made of a few burst tokens. [ffeeb73](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/commit/ffeeb733713fad61be7b42bd66923edb07038f35). - **Log noise.** Forced-offload decisions are logged on each model load instead of on every model list refresh. By @cropduster in [#4100](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/pull/4100). Addresses [#4099](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/issues/4099). - **macOS app.** IPv6 hosts are bracketed in API endpoint URLs, and the Claude Code context-scaling controls the server no longer supports are removed. By @agrover in [#4043](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/pull/4043); @LXD-8 in [#3914](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/pull/3914). ## Dependency Updates - mlx-lm `94cdcae` (main after 0.32.0) and dflash-mlx `0.1.10+omlx.9`. ## New Contributors @jerryfane in [#3908](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/pull/3908), @wyanzhao in [#3912](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/pull/3912), @samad-aghaei in [#3935](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/pull/3935), @Mast0089 in [#4011](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/pull/4011), @yoyo930021 in [#4031](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/pull/4031), @srcterm in [#4037](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/pull/4037), @agrover in [#4043](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/pull/4043), @junmo-kim in [#4065](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/pull/4065), @lybertybox443 in [#4075](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/pull/4075), @agg23 in [#4087](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/pull/4087), @vichzp in [#4117](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/pull/4117). Release notes from the release candidate and the development releases cover the rest of the 0.7.0 cycle. - [0.7.0rc1 release notes](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/releases/tag/v0.7.0rc1) - [0.7.0.dev4 release notes](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/releases/tag/v0.7.0.dev4) - [0.7.0.dev2 release notes](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/releases/tag/v0.7.0.dev2) - [0.7.0.dev1 release notes](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/releases/tag/v0.7.0.dev1) [Changes since 0.7.0rc1](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/compare/v0.7.0rc1...v0.7.0) | [Full changelog from 0.6.4](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/compare/v0.6.4...v0.7.0)

body:
# oMLX 0.7.0rc1 The release candidate for oMLX 0.7.0 brings faster Qwen prefill and decoding, new multimodal models, and the improvements introduced throughout the 0.7.0 development releases. **Download:** [macOS 26 / 27](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/releases/download/v0.7.0rc1/oMLX-0.7.0rc1-macos26-27.dmg) | [macOS 15 Sequoia](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/releases/download/v0.7.0rc1/oMLX-0.7.0rc1-macos15-sequoia.dmg) ## Faster Qwen Prefill and Generation Qwen gains faster prompt processing, batched DFlash decoding, and improved Lightning MTP. DFlash now serves concurrent Qwen3.5-family requests together, while Lightning MTP adds an adaptive depth selector. [#3797](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/pull/3797), [#3903](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/pull/3903), [62171bd](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/commit/62171bdf451a912fc6627905392692b61d3c54c5).
WorkloadModelPrompt / Concurrent requestsBeforeAfterImprovement
PrefillQwen3.8-Flash-Next oQ4e16K / 11,522 tok/s2,007 tok/s+31.9%
Qwen3.8-Flash-Next oQ4e64K / 11,326 tok/s1,716 tok/s+29.4%
4-request batch decodeQwen3.8-27B oQ4e (DFlash2)Short coding prompts / 4 requests56.9 tok/s131.5 tok/s+131.1%
Qwen3.8-27B oQ4e (Lightning MTP)Short coding prompts / 4 requests88.9 tok/s136.9 tok/s+54.0%
Measured on an **M5 Max with 128 GB unified memory**. Each comparison uses its respective pre-PR main baseline. Prefill figures are single runs with paged caching disabled. **The GDN prefill kernels are adapted from [mlx-serve](https://github.com/ddalcu/mlx-serve) by [David Dalcu](https://x.com/ddalcu).* ## New Model Support - **Ternary Bonsai 2.** Added text and vision support through updated mlx-vlm, including vision feature caching and prefix-cache reuse. [#3782](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/pull/3782). - **MiMo V2.6 multimodal support.** Compatible checkpoints with bundled multimodal sidecars now accept images, sampled-frame video, and audio through the OpenAI-compatible API, with Lightning MTP and DFlash for faster generation. By @sayyidfareed in [#3860](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/pull/3860), @ashhart in [#3821](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/pull/3821), with MTP contributions from @sayyidfareed and @williamxie1989 integrated in [#3877](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/pull/3877). ## Less Waiting Between Messages - Partial Block Caching Previously, even a cached conversation could leave thousands of tokens to reprocess simply because they did not fill a complete cache block. oMLX now reuses that final partial block too, so the next reply starts sooner. In a 13.4K-token Qwen3.6-35B-A3B test, next-turn prefill dropped from **1,174 tokens to 37**, cutting time to first token from **0.83s to 0.42s**. [#3835](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/pull/3835). ## New Features and Improvements - **MCDMA RDMA stage links.** Supported Mac + CUDA deployments can carry the Mac-facing pipeline activation edge over a verified MCDMA RDMA link. By @ashhart in [#3869](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/pull/3869). - **Lightning MTP with expert offload.** DeepSeek V4.1 and GLM-5.3-Flash can keep their draft heads resident while offloading main-model experts. By @williamxie1989 in [#3784](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/pull/3784), [#3841](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/pull/3841). - **Broader MoE expert offload.** Added compatible Qwen3.5 MoE, GLM DSA, DeepSeek V4, and GLM-5.3 layouts, plus DeepSeek V4.1 MLX affine source checkpoints. By @LXD-8 in [#3717](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/pull/3717), [#3713](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/pull/3713); @beatakouchnir in [#3696](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/pull/3696); @williamxie1989 in [#3720](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/pull/3720). - **Configurable expert residency.** Set the resident expert fraction from 5% to 95%, including fractional percentages. By @LXD-8 in [#3714](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/pull/3714). - **Lightning MTP for text-only Gemma 4.** Checkpoints with merged MTP heads now use the existing mlx-vlm draft path while remaining text-only models. By @andyoneal in [#3561](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/pull/3561). - **Faster Qwen GDN decoding.** Automatically fuse compatible FP16/BF16 single-token GDN work on Metal, extending the original M1 Max optimization through a maintainer follow-up. By @samfenwick in [#3853](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/pull/3853). - **Extended Qwen4 fused decode.** Added an opt-in model setting for compatible community quantization recipes; fused projections can use additional resident memory. By @ddark-il in [#3890](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/pull/3890). - **Faster MiMo and GLM prefill.** Use larger model-specific prefill blocks for MiMo V2 hybrid MoE and GLM-5.3 hybrids. By @williamxie1989 in [#3872](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/pull/3872), [#3889](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/pull/3889). - **Reusable SpecPrefill draft state.** Preserve recurrent draft state at cache boundaries and restore positions from attention layers to enable hybrid draft-prefix hits. By @tc3oliver in [#3842](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/pull/3842), [#3840](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/pull/3840). - **Earlier first-token streaming.** Release the first generated chunk before continuing a decode burst. By @samfenwick in [#3854](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/pull/3854). - **Optional unauthenticated inference.** Added an explicit opt-in for inference without API keys while keeping administrative access authenticated. [#3859](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/pull/3859). ## Bug Fixes - **Lower prefill memory peaks.** Bound DeepSeek V4.1 and low-bit GLM-5.3 prefill allocations and correct V4.1 index-cache estimates. By @williamxie1989 in [#3808](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/pull/3808), [#3807](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/pull/3807). - **More accurate prefill admission.** Account for fixed reclaim costs and refresh stale memory samples before sizing chunks. By @samfenwick in [#3852](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/pull/3852); @Chuhan1112 in [#3866](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/pull/3866). - **Bounded attention memory.** Keep SDPA256 prefill on the bounded route and use tiled attention for FP32 prefill. By @tc3oliver in [#3685](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/pull/3685). Also addresses [#3795](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/issues/3795). - **Bounded expert-offload buffers.** Prevent oversized prefill staging allocations when expert offload is enabled. [#3783](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/pull/3783). - **Restored Qwen and VLM MTP speed.** Recover Qwen VLM decoding, external VLM MTP, and Qwen Lightning MTP throughput after dependency changes. [#3760](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/pull/3760), [#3789](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/pull/3789), [#3791](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/pull/3791). - **Faster Qwen4 MTP verification.** Restore fused GDN verify prework with the correct normalization variant. By @williamxie1989 in [#3776](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/pull/3776). - **MTP checkpoint loading.** Load MLX-format MTP head norms as stored instead of applying an incompatible conversion. [#3788](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/pull/3788). - **TurboQuant batch correctness.** Align rollback and attention masks for batched speculative decoding. Addresses [#3767](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/issues/3767). - **DeepSeek reasoning and batch caches.** Render echoed reasoning in its native form and remove padding from restored V4.1 batched caches. Addresses [#3758](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/issues/3758). - **Thinking and tool-call output.** Keep truncated thinking out of answer content, decode untyped Qwen tool parameters, and recognize the VLM Qwen parser. By @arnavprabhu in [#3809](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/pull/3809). Also addresses [#3796](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/issues/3796) and [#3780](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/issues/3780). - **ANE and MTP resource cleanup.** Release ANE prefill state, drain outstanding work before unloading, and drop retained VLM MTP target references. By @rockminster in [#3157](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/pull/3157). - **Clearer ANE warnings.** Report the actual minimum sequence length and account for padded chunks. By @tc3oliver in [#3746](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/pull/3746). - **Safer automatic SSD-cache sizing.** Base automatic capacity on available disk space and include offline GDN sidecars in cache maintenance. Addresses [#3829](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/issues/3829) and [#3883](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/issues/3883). - **Quiet hot-cache-only operation.** Stop disk-usage warnings when SSD caching is disabled. By @williamxie1989 in [#3781](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/pull/3781). - **Preserved cache settings.** Saving unchanged cache settings no longer unloads models or rewrites existing values. By @zviratko in [#3764](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/pull/3764). - **Recovered legacy server startup.** Handle older unauthenticated network settings without preventing the server from starting. [#3735](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/pull/3735). - **GLM checkpoint compatibility.** Accept vision_tower weight names and correctly match quantization overrides after sanitization. By @cropduster in [#3843](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/pull/3843). - **Correct oQ conversion settings.** Fix GLM-5.3 text-only sanitization and restrict DeepSeek V4.1 options to supported settings. Addresses [#3845](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/issues/3845) and [#3846](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/issues/3846). - **Model discovery.** Resolve Qwen4 model_file checkpoints correctly and use Hugging Face repository names for cache-name heuristics. By @pierou in [#3752](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/pull/3752); @maxpfingsthorn in [#3881](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/pull/3881). - **Distributed worker compatibility.** Keep HTTP dependencies out of worker imports and agree on rank-zero sampling before enabling it. By @ashhart in [#3855](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/pull/3855), [#3857](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/pull/3857). - **Chat settings and uploads.** Preserve thinking-budget edits during autosave and honor the configured audio upload limit. By @LXD-8 in [#3778](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/pull/3778); @aywengo in [#3160](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/pull/3160). - **Mobile usage history.** Keep usage-history controls and charts readable on smaller screens. By @samfenwick in [#3739](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/pull/3739). ## Highlights from Dev Releases - **Cluster v2.** Discover and pair Macs, plan and stage model deployments, and manage distributed serving with request cancellation, worker recovery, persistent prompt snapshots, and cluster-wide cache controls. By @jonathan308 in [#3155](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/pull/3155), [#3256](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/pull/3256), [#3257](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/pull/3257), [#3258](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/pull/3258), [#3516](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/pull/3516). - **One-click optimal settings and recipes.** Apply benchmarked settings for your Mac and model, or import a compatible architecture recipe from omlx.ai. [#3701](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/pull/3701). - **DeepSeek V4.1 Flash with DSpark MTP.** Added text and vision inference, tool calling, oQ quantization, and Engram SSD offload to reduce resident memory. [#3574](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/pull/3574). - **Faster DeepSeek V4.1 CED prefill.** Optional bounded replay improved prefill by up to 79% in the published M3 Ultra benchmark; this approximate mode is off by default and can change outputs. By @williamxie1989 in [#3607](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/pull/3607). - **Multi-request Lightning MTP.** Concurrent requests can use Lightning MTP on supported Qwen, DeepSeek V4.1, and GLM-5.3-Flash adapters. [#3695](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/pull/3695). Builds on the fused-batch approach by @gaineyllc. - **Faster Qwen3.8-Flash-Next generation.** Reduced host overhead and gathered QSA attention accelerate ordinary decoding and long-context MTP verification. By @Rascal in [#3469](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/pull/3469), [#3520](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/pull/3520). - **Faster Qwen3.8 prefill with SSD-backed PLE.** Host-side gathering, prefetch, and compiled mean operations delivered 8-20% faster prefill in published 16K-128K tests. By @Rascal in [#3534](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/pull/3534). - **Parallel cold-page PLE reads.** Concurrent SSD reads improve cold-page lookup throughput. By @scott-kim-7 in [#3287](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/pull/3287). Includes the cold-page gate by @williamxie1989. - **M5 INT8-activation prefill.** Optional Qwen3.5/3.6/3.8 kernels improved 32K prefill by 34.4% in the published M5 Max test; activation quantization can change outputs. By @PowerSpy in [#3548](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/pull/3548). - **MoE expert SSD offload.** Run supported MoE checkpoints with fewer resident expert weights by fetching other experts on demand from existing safetensors files. By @beatakouchnir in [#2595](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/pull/2595). Includes fixes by @fxd0h and maintainer integration for additional models. - **Customizable dashboard.** Move, resize, hide, and restore status blocks, with saved layouts and adjustable dashboard width. [#3694](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/pull/3694). - **Local usage history.** View request, token, cache, speed, and activity history in the dashboard and macOS app without storing prompts or responses. By @thatcherstudio in [#3532](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/pull/3532). - **IFM/K2-Horizon and MoVA.** Added serving, oQ quantization, reasoning and tool-call parsing, and optional ANE prefill controls. By @mbarnson in [#3486](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/pull/3486). - **Spark-X2.5.** Added model support with reasoning output and structured tool calls. By @osviel91 in [#3606](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/pull/3606). - **GLM-5.3-Flash Lightning MTP.** Added MTP-head loading, speculative rollback, and model-specific runtime integration. By @davidtorcivia in [#3228](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/pull/3228). - **Layer-streaming oQe calibration.** Calibrate supported MiniMax-M3 and Qwen3.8-Flash-Next models larger than RAM one layer at a time. By @builtbycnob in [#2161](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/pull/2161). - **More responsive concurrent requests.** Yield between contended prefill chunks and prevent queued requests from starving during active decoding. By @chenqianhe in [#3487](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/pull/3487); [#3726](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/pull/3726). Full changes and release notes from the development releases are available below. - [0.7.0.dev4 release notes](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/releases/tag/v0.7.0.dev4) - [0.7.0.dev2 release name: 0.7.0.dev4
body:
> **This release includes extensive internal changes from upgrading core libraries.** If you encounter issues with a previously working model, please open a [GitHub issue](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/issues/new/choose) with logs and switch back to dev2 for now. I plan to test this version for 1-2 days, then proceed with an RC followed by a stable release.

> If your server won't start after upgrading, a bug may be affecting externally accessible servers with API key auth disabled. Please enable auth in `settings.json` or reset all settings. A future release will show a warning to help you resolve this.

# oMLX 0.7.0.dev4

oMLX 0.7.0.dev4 brings one-click model settings from omlx.ai benchmarks, faster DeepSeek V4.1 prefill with CED, multi-request Lightning MTP, and a customizable dashboard. This release also updates core model libraries and adds layer-streaming oQe calibration and Spark-X2.5 support, alongside fixes for tool calling, vision caching, and distributed serving.

**Download:** [macOS 26 / 27](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/releases/download/v0.7.0.dev4/oMLX-0.7.0.dev4-macos26-27.dmg) | [macOS 15 Sequoia](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/releases/download/v0.7.0.dev4/oMLX-0.7.0.dev4-macos15-sequoia.dmg)

## One-Click Model Settings from Benchmarks and Recipes

[oMLX.ai](https://omlx.ai) hosts **over 450,000 benchmarks submitted by real users**. Now you can apply the fastest benchmarked settings for your Mac and model directly from oMLX, in both the web dashboard and macOS app.

- **Apply optimal settings** finds benchmarks matching your model and Mac chip. Choose a top result for prefill or generation speed and apply its settings with one click.
- **Apply custom recipe** works even when your customized model has no benchmark results. Find a model with the same architecture on oMLX.ai, copy its one-line recipe, paste it into oMLX, and click **Apply** to reuse the settings.

See [#3701](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/pull/3701).

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/80dba408-1c4f-4eb5-ba9a-bce5034bb902

## DeepSeek V4.1 CED Prefill - Up to 79% Faster Prefill

DeepSeek V4.1 now supports **CED prefill**, which reduces decoder-side attention and MoE work to a trailing token window while retaining full-context global KV from the encoder. This speeds up prompt processing, particularly for long inputs.

CED is **off by default** and available under per-model Experimental Features. It uses an approximate bounded-replay path and can change model outputs.

Benchmarked on an **M3 Ultra with 512 GiB of unified memory**, using `DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-oQ4e-mtp` with **Engram in RAM**, Code (Python) context, temperature 1, and top_p 1. SSD KV and hot prefix caching were disabled.

| Context | Prefill: dev2 | Prefill: CED ON | Prefill change | Generation: MTP OFF | Generation: MTP ON | Peak MLX | Peak RSS |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| 4K | 452.15 tok/s | 787.63 tok/s | +74.2% | 20.60 tok/s | 33.22 tok/s | 404.02 GiB | 403.15 GiB |
| 16K | 454.77 tok/s | 806.81 tok/s | +77.4% | 20.38 tok/s | 38.54 tok/s | 404.15 GiB | 403.17 GiB |
| 32K | 447.73 tok/s | 797.78 tok/s | +78.2% | 20.22 tok/s | 30.56 tok/s | 404.16 GiB | 403.19 GiB |
| 64K | 435.56 tok/s | 779.68 tok/s | +79.0% | 19.96 tok/s | 35.88 tok/s | 404.17 GiB | 403.22 GiB |

Prefill and peak memory were measured with **MTP ON**. Generation columns compare **MTP OFF and ON with CED enabled**, using 128 generated tokens.

See [#3607](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/pull/3607) and the [benchmark comment](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/pull/3607#issuecomment-5646362649).

## Multi-Request Lightning MTP

**Lightning MTP now supports concurrent requests** on supported Qwen, DeepSeek V4.1, and GLM-5.3-Flash adapters, extending the single-stream support in dev2.

Unsupported architectures retain single-request MTP and use ordinary decoding for multiple requests.

Benchmarked with **two concurrent requests** on an **M3 Ultra with 512 GiB of unified memory**, using **MLX 0.32.2** and oQ4e model bodies.

| Model | Concurrency | MTP OFF | MTP ON | Change |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Qwen3.8-27B-oQ4e-mtp | 2 | 53.86 tok/s | 84.08 tok/s | +56.1% |
| Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-oQ4e-mtp | 2 | 71.74 tok/s | 96.32 tok/s | +34.3% |
| DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-oQ4e-mtp | 2 | 18.32 tok/s | 29.02 tok/s | +58.4% |
| GLM-5.3-Flash-oQ4e-mtp | 2 | 38.38 tok/s | 45.20 tok/s | +17.8% |

This builds on the fused-batch approach introduced by @gaineyllc. See [#3695](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/pull/3695).

## Customizable Dashboard Layout

The dashboard now supports **custom layouts**. Move, resize, hide, and restore status blocks, and adjust the dashboard width to fit your screen. Layouts are saved across sessions.

See [#3694](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/pull/3694).

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/f53f3080-d9ae-4623-b6cf-1c305f35106c

## Other New Features and Improvements

- **Updated mlx-lm and mlx-vlm pins.** Adapted batching, Lightning MTP, and cache restoration to the updated libraries while preserving existing SSD caches. ([#3708](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/pull/3708), [#3719](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/pull/3719))
- **Faster admission for new requests during generation.** Prevent long chunked prefills from repeatedly delaying queued requests while decoding is active. ([#3726](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/pull/3726))
- **Global settings reset in the web dashboard and macOS app.** Restore defaults for review before saving or applying, while keeping paths and API keys. ([47de6f2b](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/commit/47de6f2b1d91a16679df416a1fe4f057d78d61ba))
- **Layer-streaming oQe calibration for models larger than RAM.** Calibrate supported MiniMax-M3 and Qwen3.8-Flash-Next checkpoints one layer at a time. ([#2161](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/pull/2161))
- **Spark-X2.5 model support.** Includes reasoning output and structured tool calls. ([#3606](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/pull/3606))
- **Improved MoE expert SSD offload.** Read missing experts in parallel and reduce repeated prefill fetches, with safer read-failure recovery. ([#3589](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/pull/3589), [#3654](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/pull/3654), [#3628](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/pull/3628))
- **Decoded-image caching for repeated screenshots and photos.** Avoid repeated image decoding in multi-turn conversations. ([#3634](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/pull/3634))
- **Better accuracy benchmark scheduling.** Worker slots refill immediately, and code scoring no longer blocks the event loop. ([#3635](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/pull/3635))
- **Enhanced Readability in the macOS app.** Added an Appearance toggle for higher-contrast text and indicators. ([#2743](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/pull/2743))
- **Improved dashboard accessibility.** Enabled mobile zoom and improved screen-reader labels and keyboard focus. ([#2669](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/pull/2669))
- **Updated macOS status layout.** Active Now appears above Usage History. ([#3584](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/pull/3584))
- **Expanded interface translations.** Added remaining UI strings to the catalog and updated Simplified Chinese translations. ([#3682](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/pull/3682), [#3684](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/pull/3684))

## Bug Fixes

- **Require API authentication for network access.** LAN and `0.0.0.0` binds now require an API key. ([09a7c437](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/commit/09a7c4376a094ffe9329fb0cf131fea31e32b038))
- **Fixed batched Lightning MTP corruption at cache boundaries.** Keep each request's boundary update isolated from other rows. ([#3724](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/pull/3724))
- **Fixed GLM pooled-cache memory growth and restoration.** Avoid cumulative KV snapshots and preserve complete pooled history across cache reuse. ([#3290](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/pull/3290), [#3710](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/pull/3710))
- **Fixed Qwen4 optimization recovery.** Retry optimized execution after transient failures instead of leaving it disabled. ([#3723](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/issues/3723))
- **Fixed Lightning MTP request joins and cache handoffs.** Avoid unnecessary history rebuilds, recover failed handoffs before resuming, and exclude prefill from batch cost measurements. ([#3702](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/issues/3702))
- **Fixed handling of unrecoverable Metal errors.** Exit when Metal rejects further GPU submissions instead of continuing in a broken state. ([#3706](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/issues/3706))
- **Fixed distributed worker failure recovery.** Failed workers no longer leave reloads and unloads stuck behind stale busy state. ([#3631](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/pull/3631), [#3663](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/pull/3663))
- **Fixed Responses namespace tools.** Preserve grouped tools, namespace information, and tool-call history across turns. ([#3664](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/pull/3664), [#3371](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/issues/3371))
- **Fixed Qwen tool-call recovery across APIs.** Preserve recoverable and unknown-tool calls; report malformed calls instead of empty successful responses. ([#844](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/issues/844), [#3693](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/pull/3693))
- **Fixed XML tool-call parsing.** Support MiniCPM5-style calls, CDATA literals, dotted or hyphenated names, and fragmented array arguments. ([#3530](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/pull/3530), [#3383](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/pull/3383), [#3624](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/pull/3624))
- **Fixed Responses and Anthropic compatibility.** Honor disabled tools, retain MCP tools, and preserve plain-text documents. ([#3383](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/pull/3383), [#3617](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/pull/3617))
- **Fixed text-only VLM checkpoint loading.** Load checkpoints without vision weights without creating a nonexistent vision tower. ([#3698](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/pull/3698))
- **Fixed Bonsai weight-format detection.** Ordinary 2-bit affine checkpoints no longer receive incompatible packed-weight loading patches. ([#3716](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/issues/3716))
- **Fixed vision prefix-cache boundaries and mixed-image cache reuse.** Prevent invalid token boundaries and incompatible cached-feature concatenation. ([#3675](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/pull/3675), [#3512](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/pull/3512))
- **Fixed recurrent cache batching and extraction.** Handle Qwen linear-cache conversion and empty VLM cache slots safely. ([#3703](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/pull/3703), [a3524a9c](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/commit/a3524a9ccd912ef21297f5e677891f9bf58f3ad4))
- **Bounded oversized image processing.** Validate upload sizes and downscale large images to limit memory use. ([#3661](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/pull/3661), [#3650](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/issues/3650))
- **Fixed Qwen ANE prefill synchronization.** Prevent subsequent tiles from overwriting pending hybrid merge inputs. ([#3588](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/pull/3588))
- **Fixed Lightning MTP sampling and checkpoint compatibility.** Respect XTC sampling, reject invalid processor contracts, and honor MTP-specific expert counts. ([#3084](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/pull/3084), [#3511](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/pull/3511), [#3659](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/pull/3659))
- **Improved chat responsiveness during embedding and reranking workloads.** Added decode fairness and fixed ModernBERT null relevance scores. ([#2873](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/pull/2873), [#3633](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/pull/3633))
- **Fixed profile validation and app/web consistency.** Validate saved settings, apply current templates, and repair stale references. ([#3674](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/pull/3674), [#3678](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/pull/3678))
- **Fixed PDF processing when the selected OCR model is missing.** Fall back to MarkItDown and show the unavailable model in settings. ([#3709](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/issues/3709))
- **Fixed macOS memory statistics compatibility.** Use portable system calls while preserving compressed-memory reporting. ([#3358](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/pull/3358), [#2983](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/issues/2983))
- **Fixed model resource cleanup.** Allow progressing cache writes to finish and make disk-backed Qwen PLE resources fork-safe. ([#3673](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/pull/3673), [#3627](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/pull/3627))
- **Improved cache diagnostics.** Distinguish expected cache-store skips from failures and report failed file cleanup. ([#3699](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/issues/3699), [#2668](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/pull/2668))
- **Fixed DeepSeek V4.1 checkpoint discovery and export metadata.** Recognize Hugging Face cache checkpoints and mark exported shards as MLX format. ([#3629](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/pull/3629), [#3583](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/pull/3583))
- **Fixed benchmark scoring and exports.** Honor explicit multiple-choice answers and preserve literal text in exports. ([#3668](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/pull/3668), [#3682](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/pull/3682))
- **Improved cluster discovery.** Skip inactive network interfaces and log failed peer handshakes. ([b702f6f2](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/commit/b702f6f2ead660fbfb967a629297aa137c240207))
- **Fixed macOS server port persistence.** Port changes survive app restarts. ([#1215](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/issues/1215))
- **Fixed minor UI inconsistencies.** Match login and chat icons to the navbar and apply dark-theme usage table borders. ([3acc260e](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/commit/3acc260e), [3a101ea8](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/commit/3a101ea8))
- **Fixed Claude plan-mode routing.** Disable automatic classification during plan mode. ([fb9df390](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/commit/fb9df390529c42ea99dd5f99ee31637ca1cbb6d3))
- **Fixed canceling global settings resets.** Restore the previous values when a reset is canceled. ([cbc1a803](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/commit/cbc1a80397796d91aa64a58c8562d5138ae125e3))

## Contributors

body:
# oMLX 0.7.0.dev2

oMLX 0.7.0.dev2 adds DeepSeek V4.1 Flash with DSpark MTP and Engram SSD offload, faster Qwen prefill on M5 Macs, and experimental MoE expert SSD offload. This release also adds Lightning MTP for GLM-5.3-Flash and fixes model loading, structured output, thinking controls, and distributed serving.

## DeepSeek V4.1 Flash with DSpark MTP and Engram SSD Offload

DeepSeek V4.1 Flash now supports text and vision inference, tool calling, and oQ quantization in oMLX. **DSpark MTP**, integrated through Lightning MTP, accelerates generation on supported `-mtp` checkpoints. **Engram SSD offload** keeps Engram tables on disk and reads the required pages on demand, reducing resident memory requirements.

Ready-to-use checkpoints:

- **[DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-oQ4e-mtp](https://huggingface.co/Jundot/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-oQ4e-mtp)**
- **[DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-oQ3e-mtp](https://huggingface.co/Jundot/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-oQ3e-mtp)** — designed to fit 256 GB machines with Engram SSD offload. Available context depends on remaining system memory.

Benchmarked on an **M3 Ultra with 512 GiB of unified memory**, using `DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-oQ4e-mtp` with **Engram in RAM**, Code (Python) context, 128 generated tokens, temperature 1.0, and prefix caching disabled. Each configuration used a 4K warm-up; each row is one sampled run, excluding model loading.

| Context | Prefill: MTP OFF | Prefill: MTP ON | Generation: MTP OFF | Generation: MTP ON | Generation change |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| 4K | 457.99 tok/s | 452.15 tok/s | 20.23 tok/s | 32.06 tok/s | +58.5% |
| 16K | 459.12 tok/s | 454.77 tok/s | 20.00 tok/s | 34.72 tok/s | +73.6% |
| 32K | 452.19 tok/s | 447.73 tok/s | 19.80 tok/s | 31.51 tok/s | +59.1% |
| 64K | 439.39 tok/s | 435.56 tok/s | 19.67 tok/s | 39.66 tok/s | +101.6% |

At 64K context, DSpark MTP improved generation throughput by **101.6%**, reaching **39.66 tok/s**. Lightning MTP remains single-stream only.

See [#3574](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/pull/3574) for implementation details and Engram SSD offload benchmarks.

## INT8-Activation Prefill for Qwen on M5 Macs — +34.4% Prefill

New prefill kernels use M5 tensor units to accelerate eligible Qwen3.5, Qwen3.6, and Qwen3.8 projections with INT8 activations. The kernels read existing packed Q4/Q5 weights directly, without creating another weight copy.

The feature is **off by default** and available under per-model Experimental Features. It requires compatible affine Q4/Q5 weights with group size 64 and cannot be combined with ANE prefill. Activation quantization can change model outputs.

By @PowerSpy in [#3548](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/pull/3548).

Maintainer benchmark on an **M5 Max**, using `Qwen3.8-27B-oQ4e-mtp` with thinking and Lightning MTP disabled. Speed figures are medians of three runs.

| Metric | INT8 OFF | INT8 ON |
|---|---:|---:|
| 32K prefill | 615.2 tok/s | **826.7 tok/s (+34.4%)** |
| Generation, 128 tokens after 32K input | 24.6 tok/s | 22.2 tok/s |
| MMLU, 1,000 questions, 5-shot | 82.9% | 83.0% |
| HumanEval, 164 questions, pass@1 | 96.34% | 95.73% |

See the [benchmark comment](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/pull/3548#issuecomment-5629700735) for details.

## MoE Expert SSD Offload

Experimental expert offload lets supported MoE models run with fewer expert weights resident in unified memory. A configurable **12.5%–75% of experts per layer** stays in memory; other experts are loaded on demand directly from the existing safetensors checkpoint. No converted checkpoint or additional weight copy is required.

The router still selects the model’s original experts. Lower residency saves memory at the cost of SSD reads, slower prefill, and lower generation throughput.

Supported models with compatible checkpoint layouts:

- **DeepSeek V4.1 Flash**, including original and oMLX-converted checkpoints.
- **Qwen3.8-Flash-Next** (`qwen4_exp`), including original and oMLX-converted checkpoints.
- **Gemma 4 MoE**.
- **OLMoE**.

Enable it in **Model Settings → Experimental Features → MoE Expert Offload** and choose the resident fraction. DeepSeek Engram SSD offload and Qwen PLE SSD offload can be enabled alongside expert offload. **Lightning MTP, DSpark MTP, and DFlash must be disabled.**

By @beatakouchnir, with fixes from @fxd0h, in [#2595](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/pull/2595), followed by maintainer integration for DeepSeek V4.1 and Qwen3.8-Flash-Next. See the [supported layouts and usage guide](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/blob/v0.7.0.dev2/docs/MoE_Expert_Offload.md).

## Other Improvements and Bug Fixes

- **Added Lightning MTP for GLM-5.3-Flash**, including MTP-head loading, speculative cache rollback, and model-specific runtime patch isolation. By @davidtorcivia in [#3228](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/pull/3228).

- **Fixed quantized GLM-5.3-Flash loading** by remapping forget-gate scales and biases alongside their weights. By @arnavprabhu in [#3570](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/pull/3570).

- **Fixed structured output on VLM engines.** Grammar masks now use the language model’s vocabulary size, preventing repeated token rejection on composite model configurations. By @L4XB in [#3551](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/pull/3551).

- **Fixed thinking-control handling.** Top-level `enable_thinking` is preserved, contradictory controls are rejected, and a zero thinking budget no longer implicitly enables thinking. By @PhilipJohnBasile in [#3559](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/pull/3559).

- **Fixed DeepSeek V4 attention selection for mixed-bit checkpoints.** Nested 2-bit and 3-bit overrides now select the appropriate reference path. By @PhilipJohnBasile in [#3560](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/pull/3560).

- **Fixed an SSD prefix-cache write race** that could discard recurrent boundary snapshots while another write was queued. By @L4XB in [#3563](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/pull/3563).

- **Improved distributed serving.** Control connections try direct transport first while preserving proxy fallback and deadlines, and progressive sharding releases temporary weight references earlier to reduce loading memory. By @xunlinkx in [#3577](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/pull/3577) and [#3578](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/pull/3578). Interrupted pairing sessions can also recover without restarting the setup process ([#3565](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/issues/3565)).

- **Fixed admin validation errors returning HTTP 500 instead of 422.** By @arnavprabhu in [#3568](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/pull/3568).

- **Corrected physical memory capacity display in the macOS app.** By @xunlinkx in [#3542](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/pull/3542).

- **Corrected oQ output dtype metadata** to reflect the selected output precision. By @andyoneal in [#3528](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/pull/3528).

## New Contributors

- @arnavprabhu made their first contribution in [#3568](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/pull/3568).
- @beatakouchnir made their first contribution in [#2595](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/pull/2595).

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/jundot/omlx/compare/v0.7.0.dev1...v0.7.0.dev2
